role: Senior Analytics Engineer ( Technical Data Analyst)
responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain complex, production-grade data models in Databricks (Gold layer) focused on performance, reliability, and reusability.
Lead requirements sessions with business stakeholders (Finance, Product), translate ambiguous needs, and act as the primary liaison to Platform and AI engineering teams.
Solve live and historical data integration challenges to eliminate conflicting metrics across systems.
Model data from CDC sources to capture full audit histories and change records.
Build automated quality checks, monitoring dashboards, and alerting systems, implement consistent naming conventions, and tag models in Unity Catalog.

Play a key role in defining uniform, company-wide metrics (a layer on top of our data registries) and actively align definitions and interpretations across the business, spotting and resolving inconsistencies like conflicting definitions.
Champion software engineering best practices, including version control, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: At BridgeFund, you can take it from idea to production in no time. That speed of execution is one of the best parts of working in our data team.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals (automated quality checks, alerting, CI/CD, automated testing) sit against at least two distinct velocity phrases - 'speed of execution is one of the best parts' and 'fast-paced scale-up environments' - so mixed.
evidence.domain_risk: We grew 55% last year and have proudly fast-tracked over EUR 700 million in loans to entrepreneurs.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A lending fintech where the data foundation feeds financing decisions and finance teams, with CDC-based 'full audit histories' explicitly required, puts errors in regulated financial territory.
evidence.collaboration_width: Finance; Product; Platform engineering; AI engineering; business analysts; data scientists
evidence.data_team_maturity: working alongside a diverse team of analytics engineers, data engineers, data analysts, and data scientists
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Multiple distinct data roles already exist and Databricks with Unity Catalog is deployed, but the mission is still to consolidate scattered data rather than operate an established governed estate.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design, build, and maintain complex, production-grade data models in Databricks (Gold layer) focused on performance, reliability, and reusability.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name specific tools and layers - Databricks Gold layer, Unity Catalog tagging, CDC sources - with precise application context throughout.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Serving as the primary technical bridge between analysts, data scientists, and platform engineers
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is the data function itself - the role owns the central data foundation and bridges analysts, data scientists and platform engineers, with Finance and Product appearing only as requirements-session partners.
evidence.autonomy_level: you are the architect and owner of our central data foundation
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Direction-setting verbs dominate - 'architect and owner', 'establish a single source of truth', 'Play a key role in defining uniform, company-wide metrics', 'Champion' - and the JD explicitly says the holder won't wait for instructions.
evidence.ai_role: you'll also design the architecture powering advanced AI applications, like our agentic LLM tool
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to build the data architecture that downstream AI applications run on, which is the ai_enabler pattern.
evidence.testing_framing: Build automated quality checks, monitoring dashboards, and alerting systems, implement consistent naming conventions, and tag models in Unity Catalog.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Quality checks, monitoring and automated testing are owned responsibility bullets with build/champion verbs rather than tools in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Eliminate "multiple truths" once and for all and establish a single source of truth across the company.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The role's stated mission is eliminating conflicting metrics and definitions - the fear is untrustworthy, contradictory numbers reaching the business, and it appears in the opening summary.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Right now, data is scattered across multiple systems.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role both establishes a new company-wide metrics layer and single source of truth and untangles existing integration problems and conflicting metrics.
evidence.work_arrangement: A hybrid model, requiring three days per week in our office.
evidence.loss_aversion: Solve live and historical data integration challenges to eliminate conflicting metrics across systems - the risk being managed is stakeholders acting on contradictory numbers drawn from scattered systems.
